from zephyr_components import BottleneckDilatedBlock, ConvLSTMCellLN

# Set a global epsilon for ratio computations as per protocol suggestion

BASE_SEED = 123 

# Global constants (not directly used in test-only mode's dummy training)

UNROLL_LENGTH = 20
GLOBAL_STEP_SIZE = NUM_ENVS * UNROLL_LENGTH

# --- Aether I's SOTA Network (adapted for probing, used in _generate_probe_metrics_jitted) ---
class SokobanSOTANetProbe(nn.Module): 
    cnn_features_1: int = 32
    cnn_features_2: int = 64
    conv_lstm_features: int = 96 
    dilation: int = 7 
    bottleneck_ratio: float = 0.25

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: Optional[jnp.ndarray], rnn_state: Optional[Dict] = None, return_intermediates: bool = False):
        x_spat = x[..., :7]
        t = jnp.mean(x[..., 7:8], axis=(1,2)) 

        B, H, W, _ = x_spat.shape

        x = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_1, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_dilation=(self.dilation, self.dilation),
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="cnn_conv1")(x_spat)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        cnn_output_for_grads_1 = x 

        x = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_2, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_dilation=(self.dilation, self.dilation),
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="cnn_conv2")(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = BottleneckBlock(self.cnn_features_2, ratio=self.bottleneck_ratio, name="bottleneck_block")(x)
        cnn_output_for_grads_2 = x 


        if rnn_state is None:
            zeros = lambda: jnp.zeros((B, H, W, self.conv_lstm_features), dtype=x.dtype)
            rnn_state = {'h': zeros(), 'c': zeros()}
        if done is not None:
            m = (1.0 - done.reshape(B,1,1,1).astype(x.dtype))
            rnn_state = {'h': rnn_state['h'] * m, 'c': rnn_state['c'] * m}

        convlstm_cell = ConvLSTMCellLN(self.conv_lstm_features, name="convlstm_cell1")
        (h1, c1), _ = convlstm_cell((rnn_state['h'], rnn_state['c']), x)
        
        convlstm_cell2 = ConvLSTMCellLN(self.conv_lstm_features, name="convlstm_cell2")
        (h2, c2), h_out_convlstm = convlstm_cell2((h1, c1), x)
        new_rnn_state_dict = {'h': h2, 'c': c2}
        
        convlstm_output_for_grads = h_out_convlstm

        attn_logits = nn.Conv(1, (1,1), padding='SAME',
                              kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="attn_conv")(h_out_convlstm)
        attn = nn.softmax(attn_logits.reshape(B, -1), axis=-1)
        h_flat = h_out_convlstm.reshape(B, -1, h_out_convlstm.shape[-1])
        z_spat = jnp.einsum('bnc,bn->bc', h_flat, attn)
        
        pooled_features_for_grads = z_spat

        z = jnp.concatenate([z_spat, t], axis=-1)

        shared_dense_output = nn.Dense(256, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="Dense_shared_0")(z)
        z = nn.relu(shared_dense_output)
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(4, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="Dense_policy_1")(z)
        value = nn.Dense(1, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="Dense_value_1")(z).squeeze(-1)
        
        if return_intermediates:
            return policy_logits, value, new_rnn_state_dict, z_spat, attn, shared_dense_output, convlstm_output_for_grads, pooled_features_for_grads
        else:
            return policy_logits, value, new_rnn_state_dict

# --- Default Residual CNN Network (Standalone, adapted for probing) ---
class DefaultResidualCNNProbe(nn.Module): 
    cnn_features_1: int
    cnn_features_2: int
    conv_lstm_features: int = 256 # For dummy rnn_state consistency in probe, matches shared_dense_output size

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: jnp.ndarray, rnn_state: Optional[Dict] = None, return_intermediates: bool = False) -> Tuple[jnp.ndarray, jnp.ndarray, Optional[Dict], ...]:
        batch_size = x.shape[0]
        
        # First convolutional block
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME', name="conv1",
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        
        # Second block with residual connection
        conv2_in = x
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME', name="conv2a",
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME', name="conv2b",
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x)
        x = x + conv2_in  # Residual connection
        x = nn.relu(x)
        
        # Third block - increase channels
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME', name="conv3",
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        
        # Fourth block with residual connection
        conv4_in = x
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME', name="conv4a",
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME', name="conv4b",
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x)
        x = x + conv4_in  # Residual connection
        x = nn.relu(x)
        cnn_output_for_grads_4 = x # Store final CNN output

        # Flatten spatial dimensions
        x_flat = x.reshape((batch_size, -1))
        z_spat = x_flat # Use flattened CNN output as spatial representation for consistency

        # Shared MLP backbone
        shared_dense_output = nn.Dense(features=self.conv_lstm_features, name="Dense_shared_0", kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(z_spat) 
        z = nn.relu(shared_dense_output)
        
        # Separate heads for policy and value
        policy_hidden = nn.Dense(features=64, name="Dense_policy_0", kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(z)
        policy_hidden = nn.relu(policy_hidden)
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(4, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="Dense_policy_1")(policy_hidden)
        
        value_hidden = nn.Dense(features=64, name="Dense_value_0", kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(z)
        value_hidden = nn.relu(value_hidden)
        value = nn.Dense(1, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="Dense_value_1")(value_hidden).squeeze(-1)
        
        new_rnn_state_dict = None # No RNN state for DefaultResidualCNN

        if return_intermediates:
            return policy_logits, value, new_rnn_state_dict, z_spat, jnp.nan, shared_dense_output, cnn_output_for_grads_4, jnp.nan 
        else:
            return policy_logits, value, new_rnn_state_dict

# --- Aether III's Hybrid SOTA Network (for probing) ---
class AetherHybridSOTANetProbe(nn.Module): 
    cnn_features_1: int = 32
    cnn_features_2: int = 64
    convlstm_features: int = 64 # Matching Zephyr II
    dilation: int = 6 # Matching Zephyr II
    bottleneck_ratio: float = 0.28 # Matching Zephyr II
    head_hidden: int = 64 # Matching Zephyr II
    steps: int = 4 # Matching Zephyr II multi-step ConvLSTM
    alpha: float = 0.25 # Matching Zephyr II's Residual Input-Norm alpha
    center_only: bool = False # Matching Zephyr II's Residual Input-Norm center_only

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: jnp.ndarray, rnn_state: Optional[Dict] = None, return_intermediates: bool = False):
        B = x.shape[0]
        
        # CNN trunk (using Zephyr II's BottleneckDilatedBlock)
        x = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_1, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="cnn_conv1")(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        x = BottleneckDilatedBlock(self.cnn_features_1, self.bottleneck_ratio, self.dilation, name="bottleneck_block1")(x)
        cnn_output_for_grads_1 = x # Store intermediate for gradients
        x = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_2, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="cnn_conv2")(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        x = BottleneckDilatedBlock(self.cnn_features_2, self.bottleneck_ratio, self.dilation, name="bottleneck_block2")(x)
        cnn_output_for_grads_2 = x # Store intermediate for gradients


        # Residual Input Normalization (from Zephyr II)
        if self.center_only:
            ln_x = nn.LayerNorm(epsilon=1e-5, use_scale=False, use_bias=False, name="input_layernorm")(x)
        else:
            ln_x = nn.LayerNorm(epsilon=1e-5, name="input_layernorm")(x)
        x = x + self.alpha * (ln_x - x)

        # RNN state init/reset
        if rnn_state is None:
            zeros = lambda: jnp.zeros((B, 8, 8, self.convlstm_features), dtype=x.dtype)
            rnn_state = {'h': zeros(), 'c': zeros()}
        if done is not None:
            m = (1.0 - done.reshape(B,1,1,1).astype(x.dtype))
            rnn_state = {'h': rnn_state['h'] * m, 'c': rnn_state['c'] * m}

        # Multi-step LN-ConvLSTM (using Zephyr II's ConvLSTMCellLN)
        h, c = rnn_state['h'], rnn_state['c']
        h_outs_list = [] # Store h_out for potential backbone grad
        for i in range(self.steps): # Loop for multi-step ConvLSTM
            (h, c), h_out_step = ConvLSTMCellLN(self.convlstm_features, name=f"convlstm_cell_{i}")((h, c), x)
            h_outs_list.append(h_out_step)
        h_out_convlstm = h_outs_list[-1] # Final output of ConvLSTM stack
        new_rnn_state_dict = {'h': h, 'c': c}
        
        convlstm_output_for_grads = h_out_convlstm # Use final h_out for backbone grad calc


        # Attention (retained from Aether's SOTA, combined with GAP as in Zephyr II)
        B_, H, W, C = h_out_convlstm.shape
        attn_logits = nn.Conv(1, (1,1), padding='SAME',
                              kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="attn_conv")(h_out_convlstm).reshape((B_, H*W))
        attn_weights = nn.softmax(attn_logits, axis=-1).reshape((B_, H*W, 1))
        tokens = h_out_convlstm.reshape((B_, H*W, C))
        attn_vec = (attn_weights * tokens).sum(axis=1)
        gap_vec = tokens.mean(axis=1) # Global Average Pooling
        z_spat = jnp.concatenate([attn_vec, gap_vec], axis=-1) # Attention ⊕ GAP head

        # Policy and Value heads
        shared_dense_output = nn.Dense(256, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="Dense_shared_0")(z_spat); z = nn.relu(shared_dense_output)
        policy_hidden_output = nn.Dense(self.head_hidden, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="Dense_policy_0")(z); z = nn.relu(policy_hidden_output)
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(4, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="Dense_policy_1")(z)
        value_hidden_output = nn.Dense(self.head_hidden, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="Dense_value_0")(z); z = nn.relu(value_hidden_output)
        value = nn.Dense(1, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="Dense_value_1")(value_hidden_output).squeeze(-1)
        
        if return_intermediates:
            # For consistency with other probes, but details will differ
            # Here: z_spat is the combined attn_vec and gap_vec
            # attn_weights is now the raw attention weights
            return policy_logits, value, new_rnn_state_dict, z_spat, attn_weights, shared_dense_output, convlstm_output_for_grads, jnp.nan # pooled_features_for_grads not directly applicable
        else:
            return policy_logits, value, new_rnn_state_dict

# --- Aether III's Hybrid Network Architecture (NO RIN Layer) for probe ---
class AetherHybridSOTANetNoRINProbe(nn.Module): 
    cnn_features_1: int = 32
    cnn_features_2: int = 64
    convlstm_features: int = 64 
    dilation: int = 6 
    bottleneck_ratio: float = 0.28 
    head_hidden: int = 64 
    steps: int = 4 

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: jnp.ndarray, rnn_state: Optional[Dict] = None, return_intermediates: bool = False):
        B = x.shape[0]
        
        # CNN trunk (using Zephyr II's BottleneckDilatedBlock)
        x = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_1, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="cnn_conv1")(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        x = BottleneckDilatedBlock(self.cnn_features_1, self.bottleneck_ratio, self.dilation, name="bottleneck_block1")(x)
        cnn_output_for_grads_1 = x 
        x = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_2, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="cnn_conv2")(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        x = BottleneckDilatedBlock(self.cnn_features_2, self.bottleneck_ratio, self.dilation, name="bottleneck_block2")(x)
        cnn_output_for_grads_2 = x 


        # --- REMOVED: Residual Input Normalization Layer ---

        # RNN state init/reset
        if rnn_state is None:
            zeros = lambda: jnp.zeros((B, 8, 8, self.convlstm_features), dtype=x.dtype)
            rnn_state = {'h': zeros(), 'c': zeros()}
        if done is not None:
            m = (1.0 - done.reshape(B,1,1,1).astype(x.dtype))
            rnn_state = {'h': rnn_state['h'] * m, 'c': rnn_state['c'] * m}

        # Multi-step LN-ConvLSTM (using Zephyr II's ConvLSTMCellLN)
        h, c = rnn_state['h'], rnn_state['c']
        h_outs_list = [] 
        for i in range(self.steps): 
            (h, c), h_out_step = ConvLSTMCellLN(self.convlstm_features, name=f"convlstm_cell_{i}")((h, c), x)
            h_outs_list.append(h_out_step)
        h_out_convlstm = h_outs_list[-1] 
        new_rnn_state_dict = {'h': h, 'c': c}
        
        convlstm_output_for_grads = h_out_convlstm


        # Attention (retained from Aether's SOTA, combined with GAP as in Zephyr II)
        B_, H, W, C = h_out_convlstm.shape
        attn_logits = nn.Conv(1, (1,1), padding='SAME',
                              kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="attn_conv")(h_out_convlstm).reshape((B_, H*W))
        attn_weights = nn.softmax(attn_logits, axis=-1).reshape((B_, H*W, 1))
        tokens = h_out_convlstm.reshape((B_, H*W, C))
        attn_vec = (attn_weights * tokens).sum(axis=1)
        gap_vec = tokens.mean(axis=1) # Global Average Pooling
        z_spat = jnp.concatenate([attn_vec, gap_vec], axis=-1) 

        # Policy and Value heads
        shared_dense_output = nn.Dense(256, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="Dense_shared_0")(z_spat); z = nn.relu(shared_dense_output)
        policy_hidden_output = nn.Dense(self.head_hidden, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="Dense_policy_0")(z); z = nn.relu(policy_hidden_output)
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(4, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="Dense_policy_1")(z)
        value_hidden_output = nn.Dense(self.head_hidden, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="Dense_value_0")(z); z = nn.relu(value_hidden_output)
        value = nn.Dense(1, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), name="Dense_value_1")(value_hidden_output).squeeze(-1)
        
        if return_intermediates:
            return policy_logits, value, new_rnn_state_dict, z_spat, attn_weights, shared_dense_output, convlstm_output_for_grads, jnp.nan 
        else:
            return policy_logits, value, new_rnn_state_dict


# --- PPO GAE Calculation ---
@jit
def calculate_gae(
    rewards: jnp.ndarray,
    values: jnp.ndarray,
    dones: jnp.ndarray,
    gamma: float = 0.97,
    gae_lambda: float = 0.97,
    next_values: jnp.ndarray = None,
) -> jnp.ndarray:
    assert next_values is not None, "next_values is required for bootstrapping"
    values_t_plus_1 = jnp.concatenate([values[:, 1:], next_values[:, None]], axis=1)
    not_done_mask = (1.0 - dones.astype(jnp.float32))
    deltas = rewards + gamma * values_t_plus_1 * not_done_mask - values
    def scan_fn(advantage_t_plus_1, t):
        delta_t = deltas[:, t]
        not_done_t = not_done_mask[:, t]
        advantage_t = delta_t + gamma * gae_lambda * not_done_t * advantage_t_plus_1
        return advantage_t, advantage_t
    _, advantages = lax.scan(
        scan_fn, jnp.zeros(values.shape[0]), jnp.arange(values.shape[1] - 1, -1, -1),
    )
    advantages = advantages[::-1].T
    return advantages

# --- Custom utility for Mean of L2 Gradient Norms ---
def compute_l2_grad_norm(grads_tree):
    return jnp.sqrt(sum(jnp.vdot(p, p) for p in jax.tree_util.tree_leaves(grads_tree)))

# --- Power Iteration for Spectral Norm ---
def _power_iteration_unjitted(matrix, num_iterations=10, key=None):
    if matrix.ndim < 2: return jnp.linalg.norm(matrix)
    if key is None: key = jax.random.PRNGKey(0)
    
    v_key, = jax.random.split(key, 1)
    v = jax.random.normal(v_key, (matrix.shape[1], 1))
    v = v / (jnp.linalg.norm(v) + EPSILON)

    for _ in range(num_iterations): 
        v = jnp.dot(matrix.T, jnp.dot(matrix, v))
        v = v / (jnp.linalg.norm(v) + EPSILON)
    
    return jnp.linalg.norm(jnp.dot(matrix, v))

power_iteration = jit(_power_iteration_unjitted, static_argnames=['num_iterations'])

# --- Pearson Correlation (for target_corr) ---
@jit
def pearson_correlation(x, y):
    x_mean = jnp.mean(x)
    y_mean = jnp.mean(y)
    numerator = jnp.sum((x - x_mean) * (y - y_mean))
    denominator_x = jnp.sqrt(jnp.sum((x - x_mean) ** 2))
    denominator_y = jnp.sqrt(jnp.sum((y - y_mean) ** 2))
    return numerator / (denominator_x * denominator_y + EPSILON)

# --- Policy KL Divergence ---
@jit
def compute_kl_divergence(p_logits, q_logits):
    p_log_probs = jax.nn.log_softmax(p_logits, axis=-1)
    q_log_probs = jax.nn.log_softmax(q_logits, axis=-1)
    p_probs = jnp.exp(p_log_probs)
    return jnp.sum(p_probs * (p_log_probs - q_log_probs), axis=-1).mean()

# Define unjitted version first
def _generate_probe_metrics_jitted_unjitted(
    network_instance: Any, 
    params: Any, 
    batch_for_probe: Dict[str, jnp.ndarray], 
    clip_epsilon_hparam: float,       
    value_loss_coef_hparam: float,

                    return_intermediates=True

                    unbatched_next_rnn_state = {'h': next_rnn_state_dict['h'][0], 'c': next_rnn_state_dict['c'][0]}
                elif isinstance(network_instance_local, DefaultResidualCNNProbe):
                    logits, value, next_rnn_state_dict, z_spat, attn_weights_dummy, shared_dense_output_inter, cnn_output_for_grads_4_dummy, pooled_features_out_dummy = network_output
                    attn_weights = jnp.nan # Scalar
                    convlstm_out = jnp.nan # Scalar
                    pooled_features_out = jnp.nan # Scalar
                    unbatched_next_rnn_state = None # CNN has no RNN state
                elif isinstance(network_instance_local, (AetherHybridSOTANetProbe, AetherHybridSOTANetNoRINProbe)): # Both hybrid architectures have RNN
                    logits, value, next_rnn_state_dict, z_spat, attn_weights, shared_dense_output_inter, convlstm_out, pooled_features_out = network_output 
                    unbatched_next_rnn_state = {'h': next_rnn_state_dict['h'][0], 'c': next_rnn_state_dict['c'][0]}
                else: 
                    logits, value, next_rnn_state_dict = network_output
                    z_spat = jnp.nan # Scalar
                    attn_weights = jnp.nan # Scalar
                    shared_dense_output_inter = jnp.nan # Scalar (renamed to avoid conflict)
                    convlstm_out = jnp.nan # Scalar
                    pooled_features_out = jnp.nan # Scalar
                    unbatched_next_rnn_state = None # Fallback has no RNN state
                
                # Robust extraction logic: Only subscript if it's a JAX array and has dimensions.
                def safe_extract_first_element(val):
                    return val[0] if isinstance(val, jnp.ndarray) and val.ndim > 0 else val

                logits_out = safe_extract_first_element(logits)
                value_out = safe_extract_first_element(value)
                z_spat_out = safe_extract_first_element(z_spat)
                attn_weights_out = safe_extract_first_element(attn_weights)
                shared_dense_out_out = safe_extract_first_element(shared_dense_output_inter)
                convlstm_out_out = safe_extract_first_element(convlstm_out)
                pooled_features_out_out = safe_extract_first_element(pooled_features_out)

                return unbatched_next_rnn_state, (logits_out, value_out, z_spat_out, attn_weights_out, shared_dense_out_out, convlstm_out_out, pooled_features_out_out)

            initial_rnn_state_for_scan = single_env_init_rnn_state 

            # Corrected unpacking for lax.scan's first return value
            if isinstance(initial_rnn_state_for_scan, dict):
                (_, _), (all_logits, all_values, all_z_spat, all_attn_weights, all_shared_dense_out, all_convlstm_out, all_pooled_features_out) = lax.scan(
                    step_fn, initial_rnn_state_for_scan, jnp.arange(UNROLL_LENGTH)
                )
            else: 
                _, (all_logits, all_values, all_z_spat, all_attn_weights, all_shared_dense_out, all_convlstm_out, all_pooled_features_out) = lax.scan(
                    step_fn, initial_rnn_state_for_scan, jnp.arange(UNROLL_LENGTH)
                )
            
            log_probs_all = jax.nn.log_softmax(all_logits, axis=-1)
            action_indices = (jnp.arange(UNROLL_LENGTH), single_env_data['actions'])
            new_log_probs = log_probs_all[action_indices]

            ratio = jnp.exp(new_log_probs - single_env_data['log_probs'])
            advantages_detached = jax.lax.stop_gradient(single_env_advantages)
            clip_epsilon = clip_epsilon_hparam 
            
            policy_loss1 = ratio * advantages_detached
            policy_loss2 = jnp.clip(ratio, 1 - clip_epsilon, 1 + clip_epsilon) * advantages_detached
            policy_loss = -jnp.mean(jnp.minimum(policy_loss1, policy_loss2))
            
            returns_detached = jax.lax.stop_gradient(single_env_returns) 
            value_loss = 0.5 * jnp.mean((all_values - returns_detached) ** 2)
            
            probs = jax.nn.softmax(all_logits, axis=-1)
            entropy = -jnp.mean(jnp.sum(probs * log_probs_all, axis=-1))

            )

        value_loss_agg = jnp.mean(all_value_losses)

    _probe_loss_and_intermediates_eval = jit(_probe_loss_and_intermediates_eval_unjitted, static_argnames=['network_instance_local']) 

    policy_loss, value_loss, entropy_loss, all_logits_batch, all_values_batch, all_z_spat_batch, all_attn_weights_batch, all_shared_dense_out_batch, all_convlstm_out_batch, all_pooled_features_out_batch = _probe_loss_and_intermediates_eval(params, batch_for_probe, network_instance_local=network_instance)

    # --- Define policy_grads_tree and value_grads_tree locally ---
    # Define functions that return the specific loss components for jax.grad
    def policy_loss_for_grad_fn(params_for_grad):
        pol_loss, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _ = _probe_loss_and_intermediates_eval(params_for_grad, batch_for_probe, network_instance_local=network_instance)
        return pol_loss

    def value_loss_for_grad_fn(params_for_grad):
